Eric Richins’ family speaks out at Kouri Richins’ sentencing Kouri Richins, the Utah mother convicted of aggravated murder for fatally poisoning her husband, Eric Richins, with a lethal dose of fentanyl in March 2022, was sentenced Wednesday to life in prison without parole.
Members of Eric Richins’ family spoke at her sentencing hearing.
“Chud the Builder”, a livestreamer known for posting controversial videos using racial slurs, is in custody after getting into a confrontation with a man that “resulted in gunfire” in front of a Tennessee courthouse Wednesday, authorities said. CNN's Manu Raju pressed House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries about the Democrats' redistricting loss in Virginia.
In a 4-3 ruling, state Supreme Court justices nullified a new congressional map that would have given Democrats the chance to win up to four additional seats in the House of Representatives. First hugs after months in ICE detention CNN captured the moment when Carlos Della Valle reunited with his community after spending nearly nine long months in ICE detention. Della Valle, who came to the US illegally in 1997, was detained last August.
His community has since rallied around him to get him out. The South Carolina Supreme Court overturned Alex Murdaugh’s murder convictions and ordered a new trial in the killing of his wife and son in June 2021, saying the trial was marred by the “improper” influence of the county clerk, Becky Hill. CNN's Dianne Gallagher reports. Florida is expected to wind down its controversial “Alligator Alcatraz” migrant detention facility sometime this summer, according to a source familiar with the planning.
